EV-000898

Packing 5 unit squares in the smallest square · Packing · status current

Definition

s(5) = the smallest side of a square that contains 5 non-overlapping squares of side 1.

s(5)=\min\{s:\ 5\text{ interior-disjoint unit squares fit in }[0,s]^2\}

Domain: arrangements of unit squares (rotations allowed) in a square. Normalisation: side length of the square; squares have side 1; a trailing '+' marks a decimal printed truncated (true value slightly larger). Direction: min.

Current value

2.70710678118654+ (exact)

Source: E. Friedman, Erich's Packing Center, Squares in Squares (updated by David Ellsworth from the Packing Center table) (page last modified 2026-09-24) https://kingbird.myphotos.cc/packing/squares_in_squares.html 2026-09-24
